newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK money markets closed for New Year holiday.
newsitem.headline: HK money markets closed for New Year holiday.

text.p: Hong Kong's interbank and government paper markets will be closed on Wednesday for the New Year holiday.
Trading will resume on Thursday, January 2.
On Tuesday, interbank rates were steady to firmer with overnight cash at 5-1/4 1/8 percent at midday and three-month money at 5-9/16 7/16 percent.
Government paper yields were little changed with the 10-, seven- and three-year Exchange Fund notes yielding 7.27, 7.01 and 6.02 percent, respectively.
